title: About | Sonido Events Melbourne
description: Sonido is a Melbourne events business running parties and pop-ups, and providing event production and equipment hire.
introCopy: Sonido is a Melbourne based speaker and party equipment rental company. We also offer on-site setup, pack down, audio mixing, DJing, maintenance and transportation of equipment. Our inventory covers a wide range of audio-visual equipment for events of all sizes.
closingCopy: Tell us about your event and we will come back to you.
